directAnswer: You can scan a QR code using your phone's camera app or a dedicated QR code scanning app, depending on your device.
summary: Scanning a QR code is a straightforward process that can be done with most smartphones using the camera or a specific app.

sections.heading: Using the Camera App
sections.body: Most modern smartphones have a built-in QR code scanner in their camera app. Simply point your camera at the QR code, and a notification will appear prompting you to take action.

sections.heading: Using a Dedicated QR Code Scanner App
sections.body: If your camera app does not support QR scanning, you can download a dedicated QR code scanner app from your app store. Open the app and follow the on-screen instructions to scan the code.

steps.title: Open the Camera App
steps.detail: Launch the camera app on your smartphone and ensure it is set to photo mode.

steps.title: Point at the QR Code
steps.detail: Align the QR code within the camera frame. Hold your phone steady until the QR code is recognized.

steps.title: Tap the Notification
steps.detail: Once the QR code is recognized, a notification will appear. Tap on it to access the linked content.

steps.title: Using a Dedicated App
steps.detail: If using a dedicated app, open it, grant any necessary permissions, and follow the prompts to scan the QR code.

faqs.question: What if my camera app doesn't scan QR codes?
faqs.answer: If your camera app doesn't support QR scanning, consider downloading a QR code scanner app from your device's app store.

faqs.question: Are there any security risks with scanning QR codes?
faqs.answer: Yes, be cautious when scanning QR codes from unknown sources, as they can lead to malicious websites or content.

faqs.question: Can I scan QR codes using older smartphones?
faqs.answer: Some older smartphones may not have built-in QR scanning capabilities, in which case a dedicated app is recommended.

caveats: Scanning QR codes requires a functioning camera and adequate lighting for optimal recognition.
